summary: Build practical climate risk skills with ISO 31000, NGFS scenarios, adaptation planning, and reporting exercises. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Carbon risk management identifies and assesses physical and transition risks linked to climate change. For enterprise risk, sustainability, business continuity, and finance professionals, this training connects that work to practical decisions about exposure and resilience. Participants practise mapping hazards and vulnerability, analyzing climate scenarios, estimating impacts, and selecting adaptation treatments while tracking controls and reporting evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess climate exposure, manage enterprise risk, coordinate resilience programmes, or translate climate information into operational and executive decisions.
modules: Climate Risk Integration and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of enterprise risk management, sustainability, business continuity, finance, or operational planning is recommended. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful. No coding or programming is required. Advanced climate analytics and disclosure topics are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, while risk registers, scenario matrices, treatment plans, and dashboards receive hands-on practice.
